shared_elements: hatched or striated infill used to render feathers/wings
frontal-facing bird head with hooked beak vs. profile bird head
raised or crossing arms of figures
justification: Both surfaces use birds/wings rendered with dense parallel hatching to suggest plumage, and both include human-like limbs (crossed arms in A, raised arm holding an object in B), but A is a vertically stacked, strictly symmetrical column of schematic raptors and a headless torso whereas B is a single large winged anthropomorphic figure in profile attending a plant with a bucket. The relationships (stacked, mirrored pairs vs. one figure reaching toward a stylised tree) and the naturalistic modelling of B's musculature and beard contrast sharply with A's flat schematic outlines.
